title: type-safe-event-broker
tagline: End-to-end type-safe pub/sub broker with automatic schema generation and zero runtime dependencies.
whatWentWrong: We bet heavily on JSON Schema validation at the gateway, but high message volumes (20,000 msgs/sec) caused V8 garbage collection pauses of over 400ms. We ended up compiling schemas into custom lightweight bitmask validators using byte arrays, which completely eliminated the GC pressure.

children.text: Every distributed team eventually encounters schema drift: frontend expects a string date, the billing service sends a unix timestamp integer, and errors only blow up in customer browsers.
We built a lightweight TypeScript message broker that enforces compile-time and runtime validation without requiring complex protobuf pipelines or heavyweight JVM infrastructure.
